SessionItem.title: Session Item Interaction
SessionItem.description: Interaction statistics for an artwork within a research session

dwellMs.description: Cumulative time in milliseconds the artwork was in the viewport

watchCompletion.description: Max percentage (0-100 or ratio) of the video watched

liked.description: Whether the artwork was liked by the participant

likedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the like button was first clicked

learnMoreClicked.description: Whether the Learn More button was clicked

learnMoreClickedAt.description: ISO timestamp when Learn More was first clicked

Session.title: Research Session
Session.description: Anonymous participant session data for high school research study

group.description: Experimental group assigned (A: Museum cards, B: Reels/AI video)

order.description: Randomized order of artwork IDs displayed to the user

startedAt.description: ISO timestamp when session was initialized

items.description: Map of artwork ID to SessionItem interaction data

phase1CompletedAt.description: ISO timestamp when phase 1 feed was completed
